newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end mixed, yen closes firmer.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end mixed, yen closes firmer.

text.p: Jan 16 - IMM currencies finished mixed, with yen ending firmer in moderate volume on widespread intervention rumors. Some said one firm bought a total of about 1,000 March yen after it cleared Weds' high at $0.008640. Another firm bought 1,000 March Swiss francs, which bounced after hitting new contract low at $0.7290. Pound cut losses made when UK rates steady.
